violations.text: The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. New Violation. Correct By: 05/28/2026

(Shredded chicken was observed held at (49DF ) degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling.PIC voluntarily disposed of food product. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/28/2026

(Chicken and deli meats) was observed not marked with the date of preparation. Ready-to-eat time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods prepared in the establishment and held for more than 24 hours must be marked with the date of preparation. New Violation. Correct By: 05/28/2026
Inspector observed prepackaged pastries lacking all required information.PIC removed from sale. New Violation. Correct By: 05/28/2026

(Walk in cooler ) located in the (retail area ) area was not in good repair. Observed ambient temperatures at 52DF. Empanadas that were prepared hour before inspection were placed in another refrigerator unit. PIC not allowed to store any TCS products in unit until repaired and/or replaced. New Violation. Correct By: 05/28/2026

The following non-food contact surfaces have an accumulation of debris: -prep shelves -exterior of slicer -all refrigeration units -retail shelves -storage shelves above 3 bay sink -kitchen and walk in cooler door -hot hold unit New Violation. Correct By: 05/28/2026
The floors in kitchen have an accumulation of soil residue and/or food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 05/28/2026

Unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment or items were observed in the (kitchen, back storage, retail, outside(side of building)) area. Establishments shall be kept free of unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment and litter to prevent harborage conditions. New Violation. Correct By: 06/11/2026
The (walls ) in the (bathroom ) area is in poor repair. Observed chipping paint. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 06/11/2026

Meat pies was observed held at (119) degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be maintained at 135 degrees Fahrenheit or above except during preparation, cooking, or cooling.PIC reheated to 165. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 04/30/2024
The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the (chlorine) sanitizing solution for the (3 bay sink ). New Violation. Correct By: 04/30/2024
The non-food contact surfaces of the slicer and food/beverage storage shelves have an accumulation of food residue, and other debris. New Violation. Correct By: 05/03/2024
Establishment is lacking a dumpster. Per PIC dumpster is expected to be delivered this week. New Violation. Correct By: 05/03/2024

Unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment or items were observed in the outside(on side of building) and back storage(inside) area. Establishments shall be kept free of unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment and litter to prevent harborage conditions. New Violation. Correct By: 05/07/2024
The ceiling in the (back storage area) area is in poor repair(observed a hole). The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 05/07/2024

The ceilings and walls in back storage area has an accumulation of soil and black residue. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 05/07/2024
